title: Add inline cell editing to object-grid with batch save support
body:
## Implementation Plan: Object-Grid Row Editing Feature

- [x] Analyze existing codebase and understand requirements
- [x] Add row editing state management to ObjectGrid component
- [x] Implement inline cell editing with double-click or Enter key
- [x] Add editable prop handling in ObjectGrid.tsx
- [x] Integrate with data-table component for editing UI
- [x] Add onCellChange callback support
- [x] Add keyboard navigation for editing (Tab, Enter, Escape)
- [x] Update DataTableSchema to support editable cells
- [x] Create tests for row editing functionality
- [x] Update documentation with row editing examples
- [x] Add Storybook examples for visual testing
- [x] Address code review feedback (remove onBlur, improve accessibility)
- [x] Add multi-cell editing support with pending changes tracking
- [x] Implement row-level save functionality
- [x] Implement batch save for multiple rows
- [x] Add visual indicators for modified rows/cells
- [x] Add tests for batch editing
- [x] Update Storybook with batch editing example
- [x] Update documentation with batch editing features
- [x] Fix code review feedback (simplify startEdit, fix test)
- [x] Enhance Storybook examples with comprehensive demonstrations
- [x] Add clear step-by-step instructions for using save buttons in Storybook
- [x] Fix SchemaRendererProvider error in data-table stories
